profile.org_note: Two reportable segments (Southeast, Central) over eleven divisions; a Regional President, Southeast (Scott Bowles) was created in January 2026, and no Central regional head is published. Land is sourced by division leadership and division land acquisition / land development managers, supported by a corporate Land Finance function; every deal goes to a Corporate Investment Committee (CEO, CFO, General Counsel, EVP Sales & Marketing and others) and is approved by CEO Greg Bennett and CFO Russell Devendorf, who are the people a land banker needs.
profile.summary: Woodstock, GA entry-level and empty-nester builder (NYSE: SDHC; founder Tom Bradbury is Executive Chairman), 2,908 closings in 2025 across 12 Southeast and Texas markets, homes priced below FHA limits. Strongly land-light: it buys finished lots under option and uses land bank option contracts (5,637 lots controlled via land bank deposits at 2025 year-end), avoiding its own land development, so it is a natural land-banking customer. Expanding into new divisions (Greenville, Chattanooga, Alabama Gulf Coast, DFW) in 2025-2026.

people.name: Gregory S. Bennett
people.title: President, Chief Executive Officer, Vice Chairman and Director
people.prior_role: Chief Operating Officer of Smith Douglas from 2015; founder of Greg Bennett Homes (2004); KB Home Atlanta EVP; Colony Homes region president
people.source_title: Smith Douglas Homes Corp. 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A)
people.note: Approves every new land deal together with the CFO after Corporate Investment Committee review (FY2025 10-K Item 1). Age 60 per 2026 proxy.

people.name: Russell Devendorf
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.prior_role: SVP and CFO of WCI Communities (2008-2017); earlier finance roles at Meritage Homes and TOUSA; Ernst & Young
people.source_title: Smith Douglas Homes Corp. 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A)
people.note: Co-approver (with CEO) of all new land deals via the Corporate Investment Committee; CEO and CFO together are the chief operating decision maker (FY2025 10-K, Q3 2026 10-Q). CPA; Certified Treasury Professional (inactive). Age 53 per 2026 proxy. No separate treasurer is disclosed.

people.name: Joe Thomas
people.title: Senior Vice President, Accounting & Finance
people.prior_role: Director, Bank of America Securities (real estate/homebuilding corporate finance, M&A and capital raising; worked on the Smith Douglas IPO)
people.source_title: Smith Douglas Homes Announces Key Leadership Appointments (press release, IR contact block)
people.note: Leads accounting and finance teams (2024-07-01 release) and is the named investor-relations contact on releases through the Q3 2026 results (2026-11-04). Closest public match to a capital-markets/treasury head; categorised here for that reason. Published contact: investors@smithdouglas.com.
